 Kylian Mbappe goals lead Real Madrid past Barcelona in El Clasico: Live updates, reaction
 Real Madrid handed Barcelona their first La Liga defeat of the season thanks to Mbappe’s double. The Athletic Live Team October 25, 2026 at 7:30 PM EDT Kylian Mbappe scored both Real Madrid goals in a big win for the visitors.   Getty Images Ed Mackey · Deputy Managing Editor, Live El Clasico result: Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid
 Real Madrid have beaten Barcelona 2-1 in the first Clasico of the season. 
 Kylian Mbappe got the goals for Jose Mourinho’s side, giving them the lead once in each half.
 He knew little about his first goal as Gerard Martin's attempted clearance crashed onto his leg and into the back of the net. And then won it for Madrid in the 88th minute after superb work from Jude Bellingham and Eduardo Camavinga.
 Barcelona equalised through Raphinha in between those goals, but have dropped points for the first time in La Liga this season. They are just two points ahead of Atletico at the top and three clear of Madrid.
 Join the discussion tab or email us: live@theathletic.com 
 SKIP ADVERTISEMENT Advertisement
 October 25, 2026 at 7:30 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter The title race is on
   La Liga Defeat tonight would have left Real Madrid nine points behind Barcelona at the top of the table.
 Instead, the gap is just three, and Diego Simeone will be happy with that result as his Atletico side are just two points back.
 October 25, 2026 at 7:20 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter On the horizon for Real Madrid
 Jose Mourinho's side are back in La Liga action next Sunday when the travel to face Racing Santander .
 Three days later, on November 4, they are on the road again to face AEK Athens in Greece in the Champions League.
 October 25, 2026 at 7:16 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter Up next for Barcelona
 Hansi Flick's side have the chance to bounce back when they return to Camp Nou on Saturday to face Alaves in La Liga.
 Then it is back to the Champions League on November 3, when they take on Aston Villa at home.
 October 25, 2026 at 7:12 PM EDT Guillermo Rai · Football Writer, Real Madrid Mourinho: 'An extraordinary performance'
   Getty Images Here is what Jose Mourinho said on the performance of his players in his post-match press conference at Camp Nou.
 💬 “It was a high-level game. I’m sure football fans around the world stopped to watch it and weren’t disappointed. 
 “As far as we’re concerned, the boys put in an extraordinary performance. They showed a lot of courage in playing out from the back against an opponent who presses very aggressively. We created some good chances to score. 
 “Obviously, Barcelona reacted strongly in the second half, but we stayed calm and organised. We never lost our composure. For me, it was a great victory for the boys.” 
 October 25, 2026 at 7:05 PM EDT Ed Mackey · Deputy Managing Editor, Live Mbappe does it again against Barcelona
   Getty Images Barcelona fans will be sick of the sight of Kylian Mbappe , and for very good reason — he has an extraordinary record against them.
 The Frenchman has 14 goals in 11 matches against Barcelona. Only Cristiano Ronaldo (20) and Karim Benzema (16) have scored more goals against them this century.
 SKIP ADVERTISEMENT Advertisement
 October 25, 2026 at 6:58 PM EDT Dermot Corrigan · La Liga Correspondent Flick ‘We are not fresh’
   Getty Images Hansi Flick has given his post-match thoughts to DAZN in Spain. And the Barcelona head coach is not happy!
 💬 “I'm not satisfied (with performance). Today you saw we are not 100 per cent fresh. Normally we are fresher, and we can create a little bit more. The second half was good. 
 “Madrid had two chances to score a second but we came back and controlled the game and we made it 1-1. I had the feeling that now it is on our side. But in the end, we made the same mistake, played into pressure, and then they directly made the counter and scored the goal. 
 “We have to accept it, it's not top for us, but defeat is also a part of the game.” 
 October 25, 2026 at 6:52 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter Lunin revels in his big moment
   Getty Images It was a big night for Andriy Lunin . And a very successful one.
 This time yesterday the Ukrainian was not sure he would be playing. Yet he ended the day in the captain's armband on the winning side in El Clasico.
 And, when he was needed, he made a big save from Gerard Martin. Not a bad day's work as the unwell Thibaut Courtois's understudy!
 October 25, 2026 at 6:46 PM EDT Tomás Hill López-Menchero · Senior Editor An iconic Mbappe winner
   Getty Images That Kylian Mbappe winner goes down as an iconic Madrid goal at the Camp Nou.
 Is it too much to say it will have reminded some Madridistas of Cristiano Ronaldo's 'calma' finish and celebration 14 years ago to seal another 2-1 win? I honestly don't think so.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:37 PM EDT Mario Cortegana · Real Madrid Correspondent, reporting from Camp Nou 'Mourinho's Clasico'
   Getty Images It’s Mourinho ’s Clasico — a victory that lends a lot of credibility to his project. Flick and Barcelona were on a roll, the game was at Camp Nou, and Courtois’s injury didn’t bode well.
 But the Portuguese coach has been getting it right in the last few weeks with tweaks to his line-ups that have improved his team both collectively and individually. He went with an attacking starting XI full of character and it paid off.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:31 PM EDT Ed Mackey · Deputy Managing Editor, Live A bad week for Barca
   Getty Images There was a 15-minute spell in that game, which started with Raphinha's equaliser, when Barcelona resembled the team that we have come to expect under Hansi Flick, but they didn't control the game consistently in the way they usually do.
 Lamine Yamal was a long way off his best while Rodri was uncharacteristically non-existent in midfield. Pau Cubarsi and Gerard Martin both had bright moments in the game but didn't work together well as a pairing at all.
 A tough week for the champions after defeats to PSG and Madrid in the space of six days.
 SKIP ADVERTISEMENT Advertisement
 October 25, 2026 at 6:25 PM EDT Ed Mackey · Deputy Managing Editor, Live Life in the old dog yet
   Getty Images He might be 63 years old, and he might not be the coach he once was, but that was a proper Jose Mourinho team putting in a proper Jose Mourinho performance.
 His team scrapped, battled and ran for the full 90 minutes and, despite having 38 per cent possession, were good value for their 2-1 win.
 There were so many impressive performances from players in white — Diomande , Bellingham and Cucurella were terrific, as was Mbappe of course.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:20 PM EDT Dermot Corrigan · La Liga Correspondent Pedri: ‘We were not ourselves’
 Barcelona's Pedri has given his reaction to defeat to DAZN in Spain.
 💬 “We did not play a great game, the first half we were not ourselves. We lacked a lot of things. We were better in the second half, deserved to equalise, but then we were caught out on the counter. 
 “In the first half we were very slow, and lost the ball carelessly many times. Against these teams you pay for that. We have to improve. 
 “We wanted to win the Clasico in front of our fans. But the season is very long. We are sad tonight, but we have to think about what comes next.” 
 October 25, 2026 at 6:15 PM EDT Tomás Hill López-Menchero · Senior Editor Real Madrid take full advantage of Barca injuries
   Getty Images Mourinho 's first visit to the Camp Nou as Madrid coach ended in a humiliating 5-0 defeat. The result in his first trip to Barca in his second spell was unexpected in an entirely different kind of way.
 I'm not sure anyone thought Madrid could compete with Barca's potent attack, but Mourinho's side took full advantage of their opponents' injury list and picked them off expertly.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:11 PM EDT Thom Harris · Football Data Writer Real Madrid's ambition pays off
   Getty Images That was an extremely impressive away performance from Real Madrid . They were focussed without the ball, denying any of Barcelona's midfield time on the ball, while they broke with purpose and energy throughout. They weren't afraid to invite that Barcelona press, hit long passes into the channels, and surge forward on the counter to attack the space in-behind the high-line.
 In many ways it was a classic Mourinho result, but the approach was adventurous and it paid off.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:07 PM EDT Dermot Corrigan · La Liga Correspondent Mourinho back in the title race
 A huge result for Madrid , and for Mourinho's new 'project' back at the Bernabeu. There were fears of his team being overwhelmed here, and falling nine points behind Barca in the table.
 Instead Madrid were cohesive and showed great intensity while the Portuguese coach's tweaks to the line-up worked out, and now they are right back in the title race with a long way still to go.
 SKIP ADVERTISEMENT Advertisement
 October 25, 2026 at 6:03 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter Let the celebrations begin!
   Getty Images Mourinho embraces Flick briefly before marching onto the field to celebrate with his players.
 There was a flashpoint towards the end triggered by a poor challenge by Balde that earned him a yellow card, but it appears to be pretty calm after the final whistle.
 October 25, 2026 at 6:01 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter FULL TIME: Real Madrid claim a famous win
   Getty Images FT’ Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid 
 It's all over at Camp Nou. Mbappe's double wins it for the visitors!
 October 25, 2026 at 6:01 PM EDT Ed Mackey · Deputy Managing Editor, Live Sensational footwork from Bellingham
 Be prepared to see clips of Bellingham's footwork in the build-up to that goal all over social media this evening.
 The England midfielder deftly danced around substitute Jesus before an incredible back-heeled pass into Camavinga.
 A superb goal and one worthy of winning any game.
 October 25, 2026 at 5:57 PM EDT Steve Madeley · Live Reporter Into the final seconds
 90+3’ Barcelona 1-2 Real Madrid 
 The game is deep into five minutes of added time. The seconds are running out for Barcelona !
